intuition: The row-major ordering makes the matrix behave like one sorted array.

brute_force.approach: Inspect each matrix value until the target is found.

optimal.approach: Binary search indices from zero to m*n-1 and map each midpoint to a row and column.

edge_cases: A one-cell matrix is either a match or a miss.
The target may be smaller than the first value or larger than the last.
